narrative:
Preble County has 27,794 registered voters, with 16.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 37.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 43.8%, a clear Democratic lean of 6.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.2% of registrants.
